decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 threshold needed for a meaningful new position, so per the strategy memory lesson from June, we're holding rather than forcing a buy on a neutral day. Existing 7 positions remain untouched — stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Today's action was muted, with the NASDAQ up just 0.4% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts to push markets decisively in either direction. Without a clear volume surge or broad-based momentum shift, institutional participation appears limited today. This kind of low-conviction, range-bound session is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，納指僅升0.4%，標普500指數升0.2%，反映市場缺乏明確催化劑帶動方向性走勢。在沒有明顯成交量放大或廣泛動能轉變的情況下,機構資金參與度似乎有限。這種低確信度、區間震盪的交易日在重大經濟數據或業績公佈之間相當常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears, rather than being invested just for the sake of staying fully invested. On a neutral day like today, holding cash below the buy threshold and waiting for a clearer signal is a disciplined choice, not inaction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留在場邊的現金，待真正出現強勁機會時才動用，而不是為了「滿倉」而勉強投資。像今天這種市況中性的交易日，持有現金並等待更明確的訊號，是一種紀律性的選擇，而非什麼都不做。
